messages:
Morgan: Quick sync — PR <https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/runtime/pull/31872|redwood/runtime#31872> is ready for canary. Needs runtime + infra + security signoffs. Can someone own the canary window tomorrow morning? Prefer 09:30–10:00 PT. Change is eviction/fallback routing config + small KV cache tweak, no model or kernel code. cc @Devin @Sasha @Kevin @Tara

Devin: I can take runtime review. Will scan the code and run a local smoke at 09:00 PT, should be quick.

Tara: I can eyeball infra impact — quick Q: is there any change to the eviction daemon or BPF hooks? If so we need infra-ops to signoff.

Morgan: No BPF/kernel changes here, just routing config and an additional flag for prefix caching. Not modifying eviction daemon binary.

Sasha: If it's config-only I can own infra and run the cluster canary. 10:30 PT also works for me if that aligns with oncall. Otherwise 09:30 is fine.

Kevin: Will do a security pass. Quick heads-up: there's a tiny key rotation tweak included — it's confined to the config loader and uses existing KMS calls. I'll run the static scan + review secrets handling. Pinging sec-oncall.

sec-oncall-bot: Security scan queued for PR 31872. Static analysis: pending. Notified sec-oncall.

ci-bot: CI results for PR 31872 — unit tests: passed, integration: passed, e2e: running.

Devin: Spent 20m — looks safe. KV cache flag only affects prefix drop behavior; added unit test. I'll post the minimal rollback steps in thread.

Devin: Canary checklist (copyable):
```
- Merge to canary branch (runtime-canary)
- Deploy canary to 10% of pods in us-west1
- Monitor latency p95 and error-rate for 30m
- Validate KV cache hit-rate stabilizes (dashboard: infra/kv-cache)
- If error-rate > 0.5% or p95 increases > 50ms -> rollback
- If ok after 30m, increase to 50% for 15m, then full
```

Sasha: I can run the rollout and watch the nodes. I'll prepare a quick node-level check script and post logs if anything odd.

Kevin: Security scan complete. No secret leaks, KMS calls are using existing keys and IAM principals. I approve from sec side, pending runtime confirmation post-canary. :white_check_mark:

Devin: Runtime smoke after canary deploy: all endpoints responding, p50/p95 within baseline. Marking runtime as green.

Sasha: Infra canary done at 09:30 PT; rolled to 10% -> 50% -> full behind the checklist, no regressions observed.

Morgan: Perfect — assigning owners: Devin (runtime), Sasha (infra/canary), Kevin (security). Plan: merge after CI completes, start canary at 09:30 PT, monitor for 30m then promote. Thanks everyone. :tada:
